verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Raise Disputes API for filing disputes and a Dispute webhook for status updates, covering initiation and some tracking, but evidence submission is only via manual zip upload through the Customer Area (explicitly a pilot feature, not a programmatic API), and there is no mention of network reason codes or provisional credit handling. missing for 10: programmatic evidence submission API, network reason code taxonomy, provisional credit handling, end-to-end resolution status detail.
